The Charter Cities Institute's white paper says its planned area of over 2,279 square kilometres makes the district over 12 times larger than Washington, DC. The Charter Cities Institute's New Cities Map catalogues over 350 master-planned cities built since 1945, and its 2024 white paper names a few as examples. The Institute defines a new city as one orchestrated by a central planner and guided by a master plan document.
